products_promotion_prices_valid.name: products_promotion_prices_valid
products_promotion_prices_valid.value:
not "app"."products"."promotion_active" or (
        "app"."products"."old_price" is not null
        and "app"."products"."old_price" > "app"."products"."price"
        and "app"."products"."promotion_ends_at" is not null
      )

products_promotion_dates_valid.name: products_promotion_dates_valid
products_promotion_dates_valid.value:
"app"."products"."promotion_starts_at" is null
        or "app"."products"."promotion_ends_at" is null
        or "app"."products"."promotion_starts_at" < "app"."products"."promotion_ends_at"
